questions.q: In a solution the quantity of common salt in 320 gm water is 31 gm. Calculate the concentration % of the solution in context of mass by mass percentage.
questions.s: $8.83\%$ is the correct answer. Dekh bhai TestRipper, concentration nikalne ke liye Solute ko Total Solution se divide karke 100 se multiply karte hain. Seedha $31 / (320 + 31) \times 100$ kar. Niche 351 banega. Approx $10\%$ ki value $35.1$ hoti hai, aur tera numerator 31 usse thoda kam hai yani $\approx 8.8\%$. Options me ek hi value match kar rahi hai! Faltu exact calculation me padke time waste mat karna.

questions.q: Population of a city X is 4,25,000. In the next three years, there is a total increase of $12\%$ in male population and increase of $20\%$ in female population, which results in male to female ratio as x:y. If the original male and female population of the city is 2,50,000 and 1,75,000 respectively, then find the value of (4x+5y).
questions.s: 31 is the correct answer. Dekh bhai TestRipper, seedha ratio multiplier laga! Naye Male $= 250k \times 1.12 = 280k$. Nayi Female $= 175k \times 1.2 = 210k$. Ratio $x:y = 280:210 = 4:3$. X aur Y mil gaya, ab seedha put kar: $4(4) + 5(3) = 16 + 15 = 31$. Bina wajeh ke equations likhne me time barbaad nahi karna!

questions.q: An ore contains $25\%$ of an alloy that has $90\%$ iron. Other than this, in the remaining $75\%$ of the ore, there is no iron. How many kilograms of the ore are needed to obtain 60 kg of pure iron?
questions.s: 266.67 kg is the correct answer. Dekh bhai TestRipper, poore ore me pure iron sirf uss $25\%$ ka $90\%$ hai, yani overall $22.5\%$ iron nikal raha hai. Hamein 60 kg chahiye toh seedha divide maar: $60 / 0.225$. Decimal hata ke fraction bana $\implies 60000 / 225 = 800 / 3 = 266.67$ kg. Fraction to percentage table tips pe honi chahiye CGL ke liye!

questions.q: The price of petrol shot up by $5\%$. Before the hike, the price was $\text{Rs. } 82$ per litre. A man travels 3045 km every month and his car gives mileage of 15 km per litre. What is the increase the monthly expenditure (to the nearest Rs.) on the man's travel due to the hike in the petrol in prices?
questions.s: $\text{Rs. } 832$ is the correct answer. Dekh bhai TestRipper, poori purani cost mat nikalna! Sirf increase pakdo. Total fuel used $= 3045 / 15 = 203$ litres. Price me jump aya hai $82$ ka $5\%$ yani $\text{Rs. } 4.1$ per litre. Total extra kharch $= 203 \times 4.1 = 832.3$. Approximation se seedha 832 tick kar aur aage badh!

questions.q: Which of the following is the least? (CHSL TIER I-$\frac{13}{11}$/2025-SHIFT 3)
questions.s: $30\%$ of 240 is the correct answer. Dekh bhai TestRipper, percentage ke zeroes dimaag me hi uda de! Pehla $2 \times 38 = 76$. Dusra $25 \times 3 = 75$. Teesra $18 \times 4.5 = 81$. Chautha $3 \times 24 = 72$. Saaf dikh raha hai 72 sabse chhota hai. CGL me in lallu sawalo pe pen uthane ki zarurat nahi hoti!

questions.q: In an examination, (A + 6)% of the students failed in Mathematics and (A - 8)% failed in Science. $28\%$ of the students failed in both the subjects. If the percentage of students who passed in both the subjects was $50\%$, then what is the value of A?
questions.s: $40\%$ is the correct answer. Dekh bhai TestRipper, Venn diagram ka universal rule laga $n(A \cup B) = n(A) + n(B) - n(A \cap B)$. Jo dono me pass hue wo $50\%$ hain, toh jo kisi na kisi me fail hue wo $100 - 50 = 50\%$ honge. Equation bani: $50 = (A + 6) + (A - 8) - 28$. Sidha chhalaang maar ke solve kar: $2A - 30 = 50 \implies 2A = 80 \implies A = 40$. Mental math ka asli khel hai!

questions.q: A stock portfolio consists of four stocks. Stock A represents $10\%$ of the portfolio and has a return of $4\%$. Stock B represents $20\%$ of the portfolio and has a return of $8\%$. Stock C represents $30\%$ of the portfolio and has a return of $3\%$. Stock D represents the remaining $40\%$ of the portfolio and has a negative-return of $6\%$. What is the average return of the portfolio?
questions.s: $0.5\%$ is the correct answer. Dekh bhai TestRipper, ye simple Weighted Average (JSM) ka case hai. Values ko direct multiply karke add maar de: $(10 \times 4 + 20 \times 8 + 30 \times 3 + 40 \times -6) / 100$. Bracket me solve karega toh $40 + 160 + 90 - 240 = 50$ aayega. $50 / 100 = 0.5\%$. Koi extra steps nahi!

questions.q: If $65\%$ of 350 - ?% of 250 + $40\%$ of 120 = 158, then find the value of ?
questions.s: 47 is the correct answer. Dekh bhai TestRipper, percentage ko decimals me soch ke multiply kar. $0.65 \times 350 = 227.5$ aur $0.4 \times 120 = 48$. Equation banegi $227.5 - 2.5x + 48 = 158$. Transpose karke seedha la: $2.5x = 117.5 \implies x = 47$. Tu isme Digital Sum bhi laga sakta tha dimaag me, time bachane ke liye!

questions.q: If the first number is $15\%$ less than the third number and the ratio of the second and third numbers is 3: 5, then by what percentage is the average of the first and third numbers more than the second number?
questions.s: $54.16\%$ is the correct answer. Dekh bhai TestRipper, Base $100$ maan le Third number ko. First ho gaya 85. Second:Third ka ratio 3:5 hai, yani 60:100. Toh Second = 60 hua. First aur Third ka Average = $(85 + 100) / 2 = 92.5$. Pucha hai ye average Second se kitna zyada hai? Gap hai $32.5$ ka, base hai $60$. Percentage nikal: $(32.5 / 60) \times 100 = 54.16\%$. Direct jumps maar approach me!

questions.q: A solution of sugar and milk contains $26\%$ sugar by weight. After boiling, 63 kg milk evaporates and the solution now contains $40\%$ of sugar. Find the original quantity of sol?
questions.s: 180 kg is the correct answer. Dekh bhai TestRipper, evaporation ke time solid quantity (Sugar) humesha constant rehti hai. Condition equate kar: $26\%$ of Original = $40\%$ of New. Inka ratio $13:20$ banega, jiska ulta total weight ka ratio hoga $20:13$. Kitne units ude? 7 units, jiski value 63 kg de rakhi hai ($1$ unit = $9$). Toh original $20$ unit ki value $180$ kg hogi! Simple inverse logic.

questions.q: In Veeru Bhai Pvt. limited company $60\%$ of the employees are men and $48\%$ of the employees are engineers and $66.66\%$ of these are men. The percentage of women who are not engineers:
questions.s: $60\%$ is the correct answer. Dekh bhai TestRipper, Total 100 logo me se Women 40 hongi. Engineers 48 hain, jisme $66.66\%$ (yani $\frac{2}{3}$) aadmi hain. Toh $\frac{2}{3} \times 48 = 32$ Male engineers hue. Bachi hui 16 Female engineers hain. Jo aurtein engineer nahi hain wo $40 - 16 = 24$ hongi. Inka percentage aurton ke hisab se pucha hai, toh $(24 / 40) \times 100 = 60\%$. Language examiner ki trap hai, tu mat fasna!

questions.q: A milkman bought 50 litres of milk for $\text{Rs. } 2000$. 5 litres spoiled. At what rate per litre should he sell the remaining milk to make a profit of $20\%$ on his total outlay?
questions.s: $\text{Rs. } 53.33$ per litre is the correct answer. Dekh bhai TestRipper, $\text{Rs. } 2000$ lagaye aur $20\%$ munafa chahiye, toh total Target vasooli $\text{Rs. } 2400$ karni hai. Doodh bacha hai bas 45 litre. Rate banega: $2400 / 45 = 160 / 3 = 53.33$. Faltu details me dhyan dena hi nahi hai!

questions.q: In a speed test a student got $30\%$ marks and failed by 25 marks. In the same speed test another student got $40\%$ marks and secured $25\%$ marks more than the essential minimum marks. Then max. marks set for speed test?
questions.s: 1250 is the correct answer. Dekh bhai TestRipper, dono situations ko pass marks ke reference me equate kar. Pehle ki condition se Passing Marks = $0.3M + 25$. Dusra student inhi pass marks se $25\%$ upar (yani $1.25$ guna) laya hai, jo ki $0.4M$ hai. Equation bani $0.4M = 1.25(0.3M + 25)$. Isko khologe toh aayega $0.025M = 31.25 \implies M = 1250$. Gaps ko equate karna best trick hai!

questions.q: For a number, greater than one, the difference between itself and its reciprocal is $20\%$ of the sum of itself and its reciprocal. By how much percentage (nearest to an integer) is the square of the number less than its cube?
questions.s: 18 is the correct answer. Dekh bhai TestRipper, algebra ka combination! Equation likh: $x - \frac{1}{x} = 0.2(x + \frac{1}{x})$. Isko solve karega toh sidha $x^2 = 1.5$ aayega. Square aur Cube me percentage difference $(1 - 1/x) \times 100$ se nikalta hai. $1 - 1/\sqrt{1.5} = 1 - 0.816 = 18.3\%$. Nearest integer 18 hit karke skip maar!

questions.q: If decreasing 120 by x% gives the same result as increasing 40 by x% then x% of 720 is what percentage more than (x+15)% of 200? (Round off to the nearest integer)
questions.s: $177\%$ is the correct answer. Dekh bhai TestRipper, equation $120(1 - x/100) = 40(1 + x/100)$ banegi. Ratio solve karega toh X ki direct value $50$ aa jayegi. Ab $50\%$ of 720 = 360, aur $(50+15)\%$ of 200 = 130 nikal liya. Inka growth percentage $(230/130) \times 100 \approx 177\%$ aayega. Calculation fast rakhega toh hi ye double-step sawal jaldi hoga.

questions.q: The total cost of 5 pens and 3 notebooks is 130. If the cost of pen is decreased by $25\%$ and that of the notebook is increased by $10\%$ then total cost of 3 pens and 2 notebooks will be 67. what is the total original cost (in) of 6 pens and 4 notebook?
questions.s: 160 is the correct answer. Dekh bhai TestRipper, linear equations ko smartly udaate hain. Eq 1: $5P + 3N = 130$. Dusri condition se Eq 2: $0.75P \times 3 + 1.1N \times 2 = 67$, jo ki $45P + 44N = 1340$ ban jayegi. Sidha substitution ya equating karega toh P=20, N=10 aayega. Question me $6P + 4N$ pucha hai, $120 + 40 = 160$ direct answer! Jumps mar ke time bacha!

questions.q: A man started off a business with a certain capital amount. In the first year, he earned $40\%$ profit and donated $14.28\%$ of the total capital (initial amount + profit). He followed the same procedure with the remaining capital after the second and the third year. If at the end of the three years, he is left with 4320, what was the initial amount with which the man started his business?
questions.s: 2500 is the correct answer. Dekh bhai TestRipper, fractions ka khel dekh. $14.28\%$ matlab $1/7$ donate kiya. Profit hai $40\%$ (yani $1.4$ guna). Donation ke baad bacha $1.4 \times (6/7) = 1.2$. Yani har saal capital $1.2$ times ho raha hai. 3 saal baad ki value $C \times (1.2)^3 = 4320$ hai. $C = 4320 / 1.728 = 2500$. Multiplier OP trick hai ye compound growth ki!

questions.q: Suresh decides to donate $46.67\%$ of his monthly salary but later he donates 4900 which is $22.22\%$ less than the amount he planned to donate earlier then find the monthly income of Suresh.
questions.s: 13500 is the correct answer. Dekh bhai TestRipper, $46.67\%$ ko break kar ($40\% + 6.67\%$), iska fraction $7/15$ banta hai. Aur $22.22\%$ hota hai $2/9$. Naya donation uske planned ka $7/9$ reh gaya. Equation bana: $(7/9) \times (7/15) \times \text{Income} = 4900$. Khachakhach kaat de: $\text{Income} = 4900 \times 135 / 49 = 13500$. Standard fractions ki mastery zaruri hai!

questions.q: A stationary supplier ordered 8 boxes of premium pens and some boxes of standard pens. The price of premium pens per box was twice that of standard pens. When the order was delivered, the number of boxes of premium and standard pens had been accidentally interchanged. This increased the total bill by $25\%$. What was the ratio of the original number of premium pens to the original number of boxes of standard pens? (CGL TIER I- $\frac{13}{09}$/2025 - SHIFT 3)
questions.s: 1:2 is the correct answer. Dekh bhai TestRipper, Price ka ratio 2:1 hai. Original bill ki value aayegi $8(2) + x(1) = 16 + x$. Naya (interchanged) bill banega $x(2) + 8(1) = 2x + 8$. Naya bill $25\%$ zyada hai, isliye $(16+x) \times 1.25 = 2x + 8$. Thodi si algebra aur $x = 16$ niklega. Ratio pucha hai Premium aur Standard boxes ka, toh $8:16 = 1:2$. Lightning speed se udao aise questions!
